name: dobe_push2_lean
desc: pink goo doberman hugging someone tightly is pushed away and gradually leans its whole upper body far backward toward the viewer while still holding on with its arm, thick sticky goo strings stretching longer and longer between its body and the hugged person and the pillar, head drops back showing a calm closed-eye faint smirk, lower body stays merged in the dripping goo, smooth gradual motion
